title: Admin login, tabs and role protection
steps: Use Vivek; exercise all sections and protected navigation.
expected: Correct admin identity and no role leakage.

title: Approve pending customer and set temporary PIN
steps: Approve a pending customer and inspect customer state/login.
expected: Status approved, must-change flag, session version advance, same profile/order links.

title: Admin reset and failed-login assistance
steps: Reset customer/agent during active runs; inspect 3+ failure queue; resolve and contact links.
expected: Only admin reset; correct recipient/help row, old session invalidated, no delivery or can data lost.

title: Block/unblock and warm-client reflection
steps: Block/unblock customer/agent while open; try checkout/pickup.
expected: Correct immediate refusal/return access, retained history and assignments.

title: Controlled phone change and duplicate prevention
steps: Try duplicate phone; change with temporary PIN; restore original.
expected: Same profile ID and ownership; session invalidated; no SMS OTP; all three known phone/PIN pairs restored.

title: Ad hoc retail and manual can recovery
steps: Create for selected customer, optional assignment, pack/cancel/deliver; reserve recovery.
expected: Correct customer/agent references; no sales until retail delivery; no anonymous/duplicate recovery reservation.

title: Assign/reassign, packing and cancellation race
steps: Use online/offline/blocked agents, change assignment and race customer cancellation with packing.
expected: Authoritative ownership/availability, old/new/customer/admin events, no duplicate state or orphan work.

title: Create/edit/default/archive all payment scanner actions
steps: Upload matching QR/UPI, change default, edit metadata during/after closure, archive default.
expected: Single active default, agent sees same scanner, frozen delivered payee, totals retained, valid limits and edit window.

title: Offer presets, photo upload, edit/reorder/active/delete
steps: Create each template, upload/cancel invalid/large photo, reorder/toggle/archive and tap as customer.
expected: Accurate preview and limits, intended product target, honest offer text, no legacy resurrection.

title: Create/edit/stock/archive product
steps: Change product name/price/unit/category, stock/soft-delete and inspect customer/cart/history.
expected: Live catalog reflects allowed changes, historical price snapshots preserved, no unavailable checkout.

title: Shop instant toggle, slots and delivery pricing
steps: Modify instant availability, hours/overrides, slots, fees/minimum/free-delivery threshold and contact.
expected: Correct checkout/agent behavior; scheduled ordering remains possible when instant is off.

title: Revenue, popular products, orders and customer expense
steps: Capture all views before and after every stage with COD, UPI, cancelled and recovery work; date-filter.
expected: Retail/recovery segregated; admin/agent/customer figures reconcile; popularity quantity and customer spend rankings correct; no unverifiable ETA claim.

title: Inbox read/open/all-read/delete/clear and pending help
steps: Act on order, assignment, delivery, signup and account-help notices.
expected: Addressed to actual admin ID; right destination, badges/read state persist; other role inbox unaffected.

title: Agent create/edit/online/archive and permissions
steps: Use disposable local fixture; create with temporary PIN, reject duplicate phone, edit/assign/archive.
expected: No orphan work, historical links kept; admin server route denial visible; real named accounts preserved.

title: All admin controls and offline/failure recovery
steps: Exercise each inventoried admin action, modal cancel/back, empty queues, load-more and failed writes.
expected: No false success/empty state or accidental duplicate; affected roles and data stay consistent.
